messages:
jordan: alert from object-scan: 5 backup objects in prod missing SSE metadata when scanned during daily audit. path: s3://redwood-prod-backups/backups/2026-03-21/tenant-99/...
lee: can you paste the object keys?
jordan: snap-2026-03-20-99a.tar.gz, snap-2026-03-20-99b.tar.gz, snap-2026-03-20-99c.tar.gz, snap-2026-03-20-99d.tar.gz, snap-2026-03-20-99e.tar.gz
priya: i just checked the uploader deployment at 2026-03-20T23:40Z — env var UPLOADER_SSE was changed from "aws:kms" to "none" in that roll. looks like a config drift in the deploy.
devops-bot: deploy webhook: service=backup-agent env=prod user=ci-bot commit=1a2b3c diff link=https://git.internal/infra/commit/1a2b3c at 2026-03-20T23:40:12Z
lee: oh no. so uploads after that time would use no SSE header. we need containment first: prevent further unencrypted uploads.
oncall-sre: i can apply a bucket-level policy to require server-side encryption on PutObject. i'll push a deny that rejects PutObject if x-amz-server-side-encryption is missing. that will keep existing objects but block new bad ones.
jordan: please do. also freeze that deploy revision in CD to stop rollbacks from flipping back.
priya: pushing hotfix now: revert UPLOADER_SSE to aws:kms in prod config and deploy. will create a PR to add a terraform guard.
security-bot: quick audit: cloudtrail shows 5 PutObject calls from role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-agent-role between 2026-03-20T23:41:00Z and 2026-03-20T23:47:00Z. objects written without SSE header.
compliance: need tenant list and data classification. any of these tenants flagged PII?
jordan: tenant-99 has user emails, maybe names. marking as potential PII. starting spreadsheet INF-5400.
lee: containment done: applied PutObject deny on bucket redwood-prod-backups for requests without x-amz-server-side-encryption at 2026-03-21T00:05:10Z. added temporary deny of role backup-agent-role for PutObject until config confirmed.
priya: reverted env var and redeployed backup-agent at 2026-03-21T00:12Z. new uploads now show SSE-KMS header.
oncall-sre: question on remediation: do we rotate the CMK? rotating won't change objects already stored unencrypted. options: 1) re-upload from secure vault 2) restore to ephemeral host and re-put with SSE 3) mark objects as exposed and run data access review.
jordan: first choice is to re-ingest re-encrypted copies if we have the plaintext in our secure ingest vault. check agent upstream copies for the five objects.
lee: i checked the ingest pipeline — we keep a short-term encrypted cache for 7 days; these are within window. we can stream from the cache and re-put with SSE-KMS. plan: stream, compute sha256, re-put with --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef12, verify checksum.
priya: script ready, will run under restricted CI runner. example:
```
aws s3 cp s3://internal-cache/tenant-99/snap-2026-03-20-99a.tar.gz - | \
aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-prod-backups/backups/2026-03-20/tenant-99/snap-2026-03-20-99a.tar.gz --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef12
```
lee: please record the old object etags and new checksums in INF-5400. compliance wants timeline.
security-bot: flagged incident SEV-3; notified compliance and legal. created workspace incident INF-5400 and recommended tenant notification draft.
compliance: draft tenant notice should be brief: explain subset of backups uploaded without server-side encryption due to config change, we re-encrypted and verified integrity, no evidence of access. include timeframe and affected backup IDs.
oncall-sre: remediation status: re-upload job started at 2026-03-21T00:30Z. estimated completion 10 minutes. will post diffs.
lee: long term fixes: - add CI policy test to block env var UPLOADER_SSE from being set to "none" in prod - enforce bucket default encryption SSE-KMS at bucket level - add terraform pre-apply hook to detect removals of kms:Encrypt from uploader role - tag backup objects with "encrypted=true" and add cloudwatch metric for PutObject without SSE header
priya: opened PR to infra: revert, add bucket default encryption, CI guard, and pre-apply checks. link: https://git.internal/infra/terraform/pulls/500
jordan: also add an automated daily audit report and pager for any PutObject without server-side-encryption header. make that alert a SEV-3 if >0 in prod.
security-bot: added CloudWatch rule proposal: when PutObject missing server-side-encryption AND bucket matches redwood-prod-backups -> send to eng-security and create Jira INF-5400.
compliance: please attach export of cloudtrail events and S3 object metadata to the incident. we need proof of re-encryption and checksums.
oncall-sre: re-upload finished at 2026-03-21T00:38:40Z. checksums match originals. replaced objects now have SSE-KMS metadata. removed temporary bucket deny at 2026-03-21T01:00Z after confirming no further misuploads and infra PR merged to revert config in prod.
jordan: closing notes: blame is config drift during quick rollback in deploy pipeline. action owners: priya infra PR, lee add CI guard and cloudwatch alarm, jordan tenant comms + INF-5400, oncall-sre verified re-uploads. thanks all.
